stx.text: Killian Lu's stray ink magic corrupts Dina's resurrection spell, turning pests into a living swamp monster, and Dina drags him away from the site after recognizing him as Dean Lu's son.

The two bond over losing their mothers and fight the creature together, until it mortally wounds Killian, and Dina sacrifices the spell in her blood to cure him, so that for the first time in his life he knows compassion.

In a class duel with Professor Razineth, Killian conjures ink spheres and shackles, but Razineth hits him with a black ink arrow, and Fannessa Fjyorne's elixir heals his throat and floods him with power.

He signs mercy and heals Vickus with white light, and when Fannessa reveals herself as an Oriq agent and offers a mask, Killian declines, encasing her in light and shooting a golden arrow of mercy into her, after which his father Embrose shows a faint sign of approval.
